choices.public: Everyone sees it: both players and spectators.
choices.owner_count: Only the owner sees the contents; the opponent and spectators see how many there are.
choices.owner_only: Only the owner sees it; the opponent does not even see a count.
choices.server_only: Never leaves the server: not even the owner sees it.
choices.until_revealed: Secret until an event reveals it (name the event in the note).

items.label: Configuration
items.description: Maps, Marine Worlds, player names, which base projects were drawn.
items.why: Everyone needs it to read the board.

items.label: Seed
items.description: The random seed and the known deck prefix: they decide the deck order.
items.why: Whoever has the seed can compute every future draw.

items.label: Random generator state
items.description: The 64 bit state of the engine's random generator.
items.why: Same reason as the seed.

items.label: Phase, turn, active player, round, break track
items.description: Where the game is.

items.label: Draw pile: contents and order
items.description: The cards still in the draw pile, top first.
items.why: The order is the secret.

items.label: Draw pile: number of cards
items.description: How many cards are left.
items.why: Physical game: the pile is visible.

items.label: Discard pile
items.description: All discarded cards and their order.
items.why: Face up in the physical game.

items.label: Endgame (final scoring) deck: contents
items.description: The final scoring cards not yet dealt.

items.label: Discarded endgame cards
items.description: Final scoring cards discarded at conservation 10 or at the start.
items.why: Face down in the physical game; may be revealed at the end.

items.label: Display (the 6 folders)
items.description: The cards in reach.

items.label: Base conservation projects in play
items.description: The 3 base projects of the game.

items.label: Base projects not in play
items.description: The other base projects (Assertion fetches one of them).
items.why: Players can work them out anyway.

items.label: Conservation projects played during the game
Association board
items.description: Partner zoo and university tiles on offer.

items.label: Conservation 5 / 8 reward options
items.description: The random bonuses still on offer.

items.label: Action in progress
items.description: Which action card, strength and variant the active player is using.

items.label: Pending effects and the open decision
items.description: What the active player still has to resolve (kinds, not the secret contents).
items.why: Opponents see 'X must resolve Perception 2'; the revealed cards follow the reveal rules below.

items.label: Action card draft
items.description: The variants each player is offered and picks.
items.why: Both choose at the same time: nothing is shown until both have chosen, or until the draft is over.

items.label: Result
items.description: Final scores, winner, how the game ended.

items.label: End of game trigger, final turns
Money, appeal, conservation, reputation, X tokens
items.description: The tracks.

items.label: Hand (animals, sponsors, projects)
items.why: The opponent knows how many.

items.label: Endgame cards in hand
items.description: The player's final scoring cards.

items.label: Initial offer (the 8 dealt cards)
items.description: Before the first discard.

items.label: Cards stored (map 11 notepad)
items.why: Face down.

items.label: Cards pouched under an animal / cards under another card
items.why: Face down in the physical game.

items.label: Workers, partner zoos, universities, project tokens, marks
Internal flags (once per turn markers, map counters)
items.description: Engine bookkeeping.
items.why: Check the individual flags before sending them.

items.label: Icon counters
items.description: Derived from the zoo.

items.label: Cards drawn from the draw pile
items.description: Draw, Sprint, Cards action, income.
items.why: The owner sees the cards, the opponent how many.

items.label: Cards taken from the display
items.description: Take in range, snap.

items.label: Reveal the X topmost cards (Hunter, Perception, Scuba Dive)
items.description: All the revealed cards.
items.why: 'Reveal' means shown to everybody.

items.label: The card kept after a reveal
items.description: Goes to the hand of the player.
items.why: It was shown to all.

items.label: Digging
items.description: Discard one hand card, draw one.
items.why: The discarded card is public (discard pile), the new one is not.

items.label: Scavenging
items.description: Discard from the discard pile and draw.

items.label: Search effects (university, Assertion, Waza, management plans)
items.description: The card found in the draw pile.
items.why: The found card is shown; the rest of the pile is not.

items.label: Monkey Gang
items.description: Look at cards and tuck them under the draw pile.
items.why: Contents and order of the tucked cards stay secret.

items.label: Pilfering
items.description: A card moves between the hands.
items.why: Name who sees which card in the note.

items.label: Discard from the hand (break limit, Cards action, effects)
items.why: It goes to the face up discard pile.

items.label: Initial discard (4 of 8)
items.why: Goes to the discard pile.

items.label: Endgame card discarded (conservation 10)
items.description: Which final scoring card was discarded.

items.label: Playing an animal / sponsor / project
items.description: The card leaves the hand and becomes public.

items.label: Final scoring cards at the end
items.why: Revealed to score them.

items.label: Draft picks and offers
items.why: See game.draft.

items.label: Display refill
items.description: New cards come from the draw pile onto the display.

items.label: Move log text
items.description: The sentence for each move ('X plays Y').
items.why: Written per viewer: card names only where the viewer may see them.

items.label: The opponent's legal actions
items.why: They would reveal the hand.
